title: Qalqalah in practice: Al-Mutaffifin and surahs we know: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Mutaffifin and the sifat of weakness and emphasis
source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 25 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Qalqalah in practice rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 25. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ (٢٢) عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ (٢٣) تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ (٢٤)

keywords.def: an echo or bounce on ق ط ب ج د when they have a sukoon
the tongue covers the roof of the mouth: ص ض ط ظ

questions.q: Recite Al-Ikhlas 112:3 to 4, stopping at each ayah, and show the qalqalah.
questions.a: يَلِدْ and يُولَدْ: large qalqalah on د at the stop.

questions.q: How many qalqalah letters are there?
Pairs in breakout rooms: recite 83:1 to 24 to your partner, who marks every qalqalah and itbaq letter on the checklist.
questions.a: Partner ticks each qalqalah and itbaq letter said correctly and gives one target.

questions.q: Extend: find a large qalqalah at the end of an ayah in Al-Falaq.

questions.a: A) large qalqalah. At a stop the ق gets a sukoon and a large bounce.

questions.q: Think again: If the bounce is too big it sounds like a new vowel; if it is too small the letter disappears. How do you find the middle?
questions.a: Listen to the teacher, copy, and check with a partner: a short, clear echo, no new vowel.
